_comment: Curated icon overrides for the Library sidebar. Fetched from GitHub raw at runtime
(RemoteGameIconsService), cached locally and refreshed at most once a day - so a game
can be covered for everyone by editing this file on master, with no release needed.
Cached locally and refreshed at most once a day.
Keys are matched case-insensitively against the game name shown on a clip (the display
name stored on a clip, or cleaned-up executable name).
TWO ways to cover a game, in the order they're tried:
1. steamAppIds - name -> Steam app ID. Use this whenever the game HAS a Steam app but
the automatic store search can't find it: delisted titles (Rocket League) or a store
name that differs from the one shown on a clip ('Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege').
The icon still comes from Steam's own CDN, so this is the preferred form.
2. icons - name -> image URL, for games with no Steam app at all (Valorant, League of
Legends, Roblox, Minecraft). Downloads are restricted to HTTPS on the Steam CDN and
githubusercontent.com (see GameIconService.AllowedIconHostSuffixes), so an entry here
normally points at an image committed to this repo. Prefer square-ish art - wide art
Games on Steam under their own name need no entry - the store search already finds them.
Anything unresolved falls back to the icon of an installed copy, then the running game's
own executable, and finally a letter badge - so a missing entry is never fatal.
